title: Arquiteto de Dados Sênior (Foco em Snowflake)
description:

  • Domínio em Snowflake é essencial

  • Conhecimento em plataformas de Big Data (Hadoop, Spark) e ferramentas de integração de dados
  • Familiaridade com computação em nuvem (AWS, Azure Devops)

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo a Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais cresce no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for " SAP ABAP Odata" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Gympass

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Técnico em Lubrificação Sênior
description:
Técnico de Lubrificação Sr

Executar e supervisionar planos de lubrificação preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos rotativos e estáticos; Definir, avaliar e aplicar os tipos adequados de lubrificantes (graxas, óleos, fluidos especiais), assegurando conformidade com especificações técnicas e recomendações de fabricantes; Monitorar o consumo e desempenho dos lubrificantes, realizando análises de tendência e propondo melhorias de confiabilidade; Realizar coleta de óleo para análise laboratorial (físico-química e ferrográfica), interpretando resultados e recomendando ações corretivas; Implementar e manter rotas de lubrificação em sistemas digitais (CMMS/ERP), garantindo rastreabilidade das atividades; Diagnosticar falhas relacionadas a sistemas de lubrificação e propor soluções para eliminação de recorrências; Orientar e treinar equipes de manutenção quanto às melhores práticas de lubrificação e inspeção de equipamentos; Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas de manutenção, fornecendo suporte técnico sobre processos de lubrificação; Atuar junto às áreas de engenharia de manutenção e confiabilidade no desenvolvimento de novos procedimentos e otimização de intervalos de lubrificação; Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade na manipulação, armazenamento e descarte de lubrificantes.

Atividades:

Efetua os serviços de verificação de nível e reposição de lubrificantes em equipamentos;

Realiza a inspeção dos equipamentos, relativos à função lubrificação;

Efetua a troca de cargas de lubrificantes, bem como a sua purificação e filtragem;

Lubrifica os pontos de graxa e verifica o funcionamento em sistemas centralizados;

Efetua a lubrificação de correntes, guias, articulações, engrenagens, acoplamentos;

Cumpre a programação periódica de inspeção e lubrificação;

Efetua o levantamento de dados técnicos de equipamentos para elaboração do plano de lubrificação;

Efetua a substituição de elementos filtrantes;

Faz a coleta de amostras de lubrificantes para análise;

Limpeza específica de unidades hidráulicas;

Segrega lubrificantes usados, elementos filtrantes e desengraxantes para descarte;

Segue as instruções de trabalho e procedimentos inerentes à sua função, quando estas existirem;

Executa outras tarefas correlatas às descritas, a critério do superior imediato;

Análise dos laudos dos laboratórios decorrentes das análises dos lubrificantes;

Execução das práticas adequadas para coleta de amostras de lubrificantes;

Garantir a confiabilidade das Unidades Hidráulicas e de lubrificação (elementos filtrantes, nível de contaminação, pontos de coleta de amostras, etc);

Seguir, monitorar e garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos de segurança e meio ambiente da SKF e dos clientes

Garantir que os equipamentos rotativos das unidades fabris dos clientes não quebrem em emergência

Garantir os padrões da qualidade das Normas e Procedimentos ISO

Elaboração e revisão dos planos de Lubrificação Industrial

Requisitos & Competências:

Formação técnica em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Automação Industrial ou áreas relacionadas.

Conhecimento de lubrificação industrial e seus princípios.

Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de lubrificantes, métodos de aplicação e equipamentos de lubrificação. Habilidade para usar ferramentas e equipamentos de medição, como medidores de viscosidade, analisadores de óleo, entre outros.

Capacidade de interpretar dados de análise de óleo e tomar medidas adequadas com base nos resultados.

Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de trabalho em equipe.

Compromisso com a segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

title: Site Readiness Engineer
description:
About Pathlock:

Pathlock is a leader in application security, access governance, and compliance automation. Our cloud-based solutions help organizations secure critical applications, mitigate risk, and enforce policies across a diverse IT landscape.

Job Summary:

We are looking for a skilled Site Readiness Engineer (SRE) with expertise in CI/CD automation and Azure cloud technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring deployment readiness across our infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and maintaining optimal site performance within our cloud environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support application deployment and infrastructure provisioning.
  • Develop and enhance automation scripts to streamline deployment processes and minimize manual tasks.
  • Configure, manage, and optimize cloud resources in alignment with security standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to troubleshoot and resolve deployment and site readiness issues.
  • Monitor site performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement improvements to enhance system reliability and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide production deployment support and incident resolution.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for deployment processes, system configurations, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Conduct site readiness assessments and validation tests to ensure infrastructure and applications are production ready.
  • Implement and enforce Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using tools such as Terraform and ARM templates.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to deployment failures, infrastructure provisioning, and application performance.

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps, or similar roles
  • Strong proficiency in CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, or similar
  • Solid experience with Azure cloud services, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Database services and networking controls
  • Hands-on experience automating deployment workflows and infrastructure provisioning
  • Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, ARM templates, or similar tools
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar
  • Experience with GitOps tools like ArgoCD or Flux
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Strong understanding of networking principles and Azure networking services
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments
  • Must be able to read and speak fluently in English
  • Must be able to work at least some time in the US or EU time zone

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Azure certifications (Azure Developer Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, or Azure Administrator)
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as , Application Insights, ELK or Grafana
  • Experience with log aggregation and analysis tools in particular Elastic and Prometheus
  • Understanding of high availability and disaster recovery concepts
  • Experience with containerized applications with a Windows OS

Why Join Pathlock?

  • Opportunity to lead a cutting-edge cloud security platform.
  • Work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and equity options.
  • Collaborative and inclusive company culture.

title: Sr. Cisco Meraki MX Security SME
description:
Job Title: Sr. Cisco Meraki MX Security SME

Work Location: Remote - LATAM

Duration - 3 Months

Job Overview:

This role is critical to the successful execution of Client's phased deployment of Cisco Meraki MX devices and associated security technologies across multiple customer locations. Lead the technical implementation of Phase One, which includes seven sites, and will directly contribute to the customer’s digital transformation and security posture. This is a cross-functional role requiring collaboration with IT, security, and cloud teams to ensure seamless integration and operational readiness.

Job Description:

  • Conduct discovery and documentation of existing IP schema across seven customer locations.
  • Design and implement new IP subnets for Office, Wireless, and Management networks.
  • Review DHCP server configuration, scope, and scope options for each location.
  • Identify network hosts that require manual static IP modifications or changes.
  • Deploy and configure Cisco Meraki MX devices, including switch port VLAN mapping.
  • Create standardized operational templates, profiles, and dashboards for Meraki environments.
  • Establish secure VPN tunnels and configure Cisco Secure Client for endpoint protection.
  • Cisco Secure Client Integration: Ensure the use of Cisco Secure Client for secure access.
  • Endpoint and End User Connections: Create and manage connections with endpoints and end users.
  • VPN Access: Ensure VPN access is available across all devices.
  • Cloud Integration: Integrate with Azure and AWS for cloud services.
  • Integrate Cisco Duo MFA to secure access to critical applications (e.g., Pension Pro).
  • Perform Active Directory integration for centralized user management.
  • Support cloud service integration with Azure and AWS.
  • Collaborate with internal and customer teams to ensure successful deployment and knowledge transfer.
  • Participate in testing, validation, and final review phases of the project.

Experience Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise network deployment and configuration.
  • Proven experience with Cisco Meraki MX series, including dashboard configuration and VPN setup.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Duo MFA and Cisco Secure Client.
  • Familiarity with IP schema design, subnetting, and VLAN configuration.
  • Experience integrating cloud services (Azure, AWS) into enterprise networks.
  • Prior involvement in phased deployment projects across multiple physical locations is preferred.

Educational Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Cisco certifications (e.g., CCNA, Meraki CMNA) preferred.
  • Additional certifications in cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) or security (e.g., CISSP) are a plus.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Full Stack Engineer

Reports to: Director of Engineering

Position Overview

The Senior Full Stack Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining our company’s core business applications. We’re seeking a true systems analyst who thrives on solving complex business challenges and translating them into robust, scalable, and high-performing technical solutions. This individual should be equally comfortable working on both the front-end (React) and back-end (PHP, PostgreSQL, SQL) of modern web applications and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software.

Strong English communication skills are essential for this role, as you’ll be working closely with internal stakeholders, product owners, and developers across global teams. You should be able to clearly articulate technical concepts, document your work effectively, and participate in discussions and code reviews with confidence.

What You Will Do

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The individual in this position will be expected, on a regular basis, to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end functionality for enterprise-level business applications using PHP and PostgreSQL .
  • Build and enhance interactive, responsive front-end interfaces using React and modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Collaborate with other engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to enhance our company’s product line and ensure optimal system performance.
  • Write clean, well-structured, and well-tested code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and reliability.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and help define technical direction for new features and system improvements.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in full stack development, contributing ideas for process and tool improvements.
  • Mentor, guide, and provide technical support to junior developers and team members.
  • Communicate effectively with non-technical teams and management to explain technical solutions in a clear, professional manner.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation to ensure knowledge sharing and long-term maintainability of code.

What You Will Bring

  • Proven ability to write clean, well-documented, and well-tested code (samples may be requested).
  • Strong understanding of PHP , PostgreSQL , and SQL , with hands-on experience in designing, optimizing, and maintaining relational databases.
  • Proficiency with React or other modern front-end frameworks for building scalable, interactive web interfaces.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality, reliable software.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills , with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working in agile, team-based environments .
  • Experience in the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry is a plus.
  • Enjoys documenting code and processes, sharing knowledge, and continuously improving both personal and team skills.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, and globally distributed environment .

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in full stack development, including both back-end and front-end technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with PHP, PostgreSQL, SQL, and React in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects from conception to deployment.
  • Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) principles and agile methodologies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Somos hoje o maior empregador privado do País com 150 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras unidos no propósito de contribuir para uma alimentação mais acessível e de qualidade aos brasileiros e brasileiras, colaborando assim com a saúde e o bem-estar de todos e todas.

Unimos o melhor dos dois grupos e somos agora uma empresa mais diversa, com maior capacidade de inovar e causar impacto positivo na sociedade. Além de gerar mais de R$ 100 Bilhões em receitas e liderança no setor de 23% de Market Share.

Estamos investindo fortemente na simplificação e na aceleração digital, pois acreditamos que esse é o caminho para nos transformar e sermos protagonistas da mudança que queremos ver no país.

Trabalhar no Grupo Carrefour Brasil é participar diariamente de tudo isso, em um ambiente que respeita e acolhe as diferenças com muito espaço para crescer e aprender. Somos muitos e queremos ser ainda mais.

E você também pode fazer parte dessa grande jornada. Com você, seremos ainda maiores.

Sobre a área : A área Comercial de Serviços E-commerce é responsável pela venda e gestão de serviços como garantia estendida, seguros, assistências, instalações, gift cards, cartões presente Carrefour, consórcios, vale-gás, entre outros. Esses serviços são comercializados tanto no E-commerce quanto, em alguns casos, nas lojas físicas do Carrefour e do Sam’s Club. O time atua na criação de estratégias para impulsionar as vendas, no relacionamento com parceiros e na busca contínua pela melhor experiência para o cliente.

Desafios dessa posição: A missão do(a) estagiário(a) de Serviços E-commerce é apoiar a equipe na análise de informações financeiras e na execução de atividades operacionais, contribuindo para ações que impulsionem as vendas de serviços e aprimorem o desempenho da área.

O papel envolve interação com diferentes áreas do negócio, garantindo o suporte necessário aos processos internos e operacionais.

  • Consolidar e organizar dados extraídos dos sistemas Carrefour, gerando relatórios e dashboards de vendas que forneçam insights estratégicos para a equipe.
  • Apoiar negociações comerciais e contribuir para a criação e implementação de campanhas promocionais, ativações no site e ações de incentivo nas lojas.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros, operacionais e de satisfação do cliente, identificando oportunidades de melhoria na jornada de aquisição de serviços.
  • Apoiar na gestão de demandas operacionais e administrativas, como o fluxo de pedidos e a expedição de cartões presente para clientes e lojas.

Você precisa ter:

  • Estar cursando Administração, Marketing, Contabilidade ou Engenharia de Produção.
  • Experiência com relatórios, análise de dados e acompanhamento de KPIs.
  • Excel avançado para análise e estruturação de dados.

Adoraríamos se você tiver:

  • Familiaridade com sistemas de CRM e com a execução de campanhas promocionais.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager – BU Manager , you will act as the driving force behind our expansion in Brazil.

You’ll be responsible for building our market presence, developing a portfolio of strategic clients, and leading a team of Junior Business Developers. Your mission is to scale revenue, establish LittleBig as a key player in Brazil, and ensure operational excellence across all activities.

Key Responsibilities

Market Launch & Strategic Growth

  • Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for Brazil
  • Open and grow strategic accounts in targeted industries
  • Adapt LittleBig’s value proposition to local market needs and positioning

Client Development & Key Account Management

  • Drive acquisition of major enterprise clients and expand relationships with existing customers
  • Lead the full commercial cycle: prospecting, RFP responses, proposal creation, and complex negotiations
  • Represent LittleBig at the highest level with C-level and procurement stakeholders

BU Leadership & Team Management

  • Hire, coach, and manage a local team of Junior Business Developers

Talent Network Development & Delivery Oversight

  • Ensure successful execution from contracting to delivery, supported by internal teams

Performance Tracking & Governance

  • Monitor KPIs: revenue, margin, project pipeline, closing rates, team performance

  • Ensure full compliance with legal, financial, and operational standards

Profile

  • Master’s degree from a top business school, engineering school, or university
  • 3 to 7 years of experience in B2B business development, consulting, or strategic sales, ideally in international or digital environments
  • Proven track record in market development and client acquisition
  • Strong leadership skills and experience in managing high-performing teams
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution capability; data- and result-driven
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English ; French is a plus
  • Solid knowledge of digital tools and B2B sales practices (CRM, automation, AI)

title: Senior Business Analyst-Operation Analysis
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

About the job

Senior Business Analyst-Operation Analysis

Location: 100% On site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for Operation Analysis, comprehensively handling budget/target management, resource management, business analysis, B/C/D-end strategy formulation, and performance management. 2. Develop operation management frameworks for daily, weekly, and monthly cycles, compile business operation reports, identify key business signals and strategic opportunities, initiate timely discussions to reach consensus, and provide guidance for business development. 3. Utilize management tools such as targets, resources, indicators, and performance to identify business issues, provide solutions, and drive the achievement of business objectives. 4. Coordinate cross-departmental collaboration to optimize resource allocation and enhance business operational efficiency.

Job Requirements:

1. Deep understanding of Brazil market's local lifestyle and e-commerce business, with experience in developing new businesses from 0 to 1.

2.Extensive experience in budget/target management, resource management, business analysis, and performance management; strong data analysis capabilities to identify business issues based on operational data and develop and implement solutions.

3. Strong strategic planning, logical thinking, communication, coordination, and resource integration skills; effectively promoting teamwork, pushing for the implementation and optimization of commerce strategies.

4. Results-oriented, strong self-drive, learning ability, resilience; capable of quickly applying experiences from different fields; adaptable to market uncertainties; bold in innovation and breakthroughs.

Highlights:

1. The opportunity to drive the exploration of new markets and new businesses from 0 to 1, exploring new business opportunities. 2. Involved in the business growth of a country from the ground up, with exposure to various business opportunities and partners. 3. Oversee overall business operations, participate in business planning and strategy formulation, playing a key role in defining Keeta's business goals and development direction.

Please upload both your English and Portuguese resumes,thanks!

performance.

Perfil comportamental esperado

  • Energia comercial e resiliência diante de metas;
  • Capacidade de lidar com objeções e transformar oportunidades em vendas;
  • Organização e disciplina no uso de ferramentas e relatórios;
  • Espírito colaborativo e foco em resultados;
  • Comunicação clara e empática.

  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código (Git).

Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

title: Head of FP&A

Sinch is looking for a talented Head of FP&A to join us in Sao Paulo! The Director will report to the VP of FP&A - Americas located in the United States.

This leadership role is responsible for translating business strategy into financial plans, providing data-driven insights to support critical decision-making, and driving operational efficiency and financial performance improvements. The Director will also be responsible for managing, mentoring, and developing a highly performing FP&A team.

Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Responsibilities

Financial Analysis and Reporting:

  • Direct the preparation of timely, accurate, and insightful management reports (e.g., Monthly/Quarterly Business Review packages) for the Senior Leadership Team in LatAm
  • Conduct in-depth variance analysis on financial performance (Actuals vs. Budget/Forecast/Prior Year), identifying key trends, opportunities, and risks, and clearly articulating the 'story behind the numbers.'
  • Own and manage the reporting of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring metrics are relevant and drive accountability across the organization.
  • Collaborate with the Accounting and Controllership teams to ensure accurate financial data consolidation and reporting in compliance with local BR GAAP and international standards (e.g., IFRS/US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Prepare compelling financial presentations and reports for executive leadership, and other stakeholders

Strategic Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting:

  • Lead the comprehensive annual planning (Budget) and long-range planning (LRP) processes for Latin America, primarily in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, ensuring alignment with corporate strategic goals.
  • Manage the quarterly financial forecasting process, incorporating business drivers, market trends, and operational changes to ensure high accuracy and predictability.
  • Develop complex financial models (e.g., scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis) to evaluate new business initiatives, and strategic projects.

Business Partnering and Stakeholder Management:

  • Act as the primary finance partner to the General Manager - LatAm and other functional leaders (Sales, Marketing, Operations), providing financial advice and challenging assumptions.
  • Present financial results, forecasts, and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to executive management.
  • Drive continuous improvement in cost management and resource allocation, recommending actions to optimize profitability and operational efficiency.

Team Leadership and Development:

  • Manage, coach, mentor, and motivate a team of FP&A professionals, fostering a culture of high performance, analytical rigor, and professional growth.
  • Define team goals, allocate resources efficiently, and manage workflows to ensure all deliverables are met accurately and on time.
  • Lead efforts to streamline and automate FP&A processes and systems to improve efficiency and data integrity.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA degree highly desirable.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), public accounting, investment banking, or private equity; with a strong focus on operational expenses, and preferably with a large multinational corporation.
  • A minimum of 3+ years of experience managing a team of financial professionals.
  • Experience with financial planning and reporting software (Anaplan, AARO), ERP systems, CRM systems (Salesforce), and Visual Reporting (Tableau) highly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  • Proven ability to synthesize complex financial data into clear and concise insights for non-financial stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across the organization.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Previous experience in finance within a technology or telecommunications environment would be advantageous
  • Fluency in English (verbal and written) is required for effective communication with international leadership.
  • Fluency in Spanish desirable but not required.

About Hitch

Hitch builds the digital infrastructure powering modern home equity and non-QM lending. Our white-label platform enables lenders to launch HELOC, DSCR, bridge, and home equity products faster — with integrated point of sale, broker portals, and automated underwriting.

We partner with leading mortgage lenders like Deephaven Mortgage and MyEQNow to deliver a seamless borrower and broker experience.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Technical Support Engineer to join our operations and product team. You will act as the primary technical contact for our clients — diagnosing platform issues, tracing bugs, and communicating findings clearly between client operations teams and Hitch’s engineers.

This is a hands-on role ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer experience and technology.

  • Investigate client-reported issues by analyzing logs, API requests, database records, and user behavior.

  • Collaborate with developers and QA to verify fixes and regression-test key features.
  • Use tools like Postman, AWS CloudWatch, and browser developer tools to debug integrations.
  • Maintain support documentation, internal runbooks, and root-cause analyses.
  • Monitor application health metrics and proactively identify potential system issues.
  • Participate in weekly technical support syncs with Product and Engineering.
Requirements
  • 2–5 years of experience in technical support, QA engineering, or DevOps support for SaaS or fintech platforms.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication (C1 or native-level).
  • Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads , and browser console/network tools.
  • Ability to read and interpret basic SQL queries or error logs .
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when documenting issues.
  • Experience with ticketing systems (Zendesk, Linear, Asana, or Jira).
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with developers and client success teams.
Nice-to-Have
  • Background in mortgage, lending, or real estate technology (LOS, POS, or Encompass integration).
  • Knowledge of AWS , Node.js , or React debugging.
  • Experience working with Plaid, Truework, Prudent AI, or other fintech APIs .
  • Portuguese or Spanish proficiency (to collaborate with our Brazil-based engineering team).
Why Hitch
  • Work closely with a global engineering team building the future of digital lending.
  • Exposure to real-world integrations across fintech, credit, and mortgage ecosystems.
  • Growth opportunities into QA, DevOps, or Client Success Engineering.
  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

  • 1-3 years of experience in Data analysis, product data management, or a related field.

  • Strong organizational skills with an ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Attention to detail and a keen eye for product presentation and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication skills to coordinate with designers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Basic understanding of SEO and ecommerce best practices is a plus.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET / Vue.js)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience to join our U.S.-based client's product development team. This individual will work on the client's Docs product, a multi-tenant document management system built with modern .NET and Vue.js technologies. This is an opportunity to work on a sophisticated platform that serves customers primarily in the oil and gas industry with a proven 2-week release cadence.

This position requires an individual who enjoys having complete ownership of features from conception to production, encompassing database schema changes, backend APIs, and frontend interfaces, all with comprehensive test coverage. We believe in the "you build it, you own it, you ship it" philosophy. You'll work in an environment that values craftsmanship, modern development practices, and strategic use of AI coding assistants to amplify productivity.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across nine countries.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own Features End-to-End: Take complete ownership of features from initial design through production deployment, including database, backend ( .NET), frontend (Vue.js), testing, deployment, and post-launch monitoring
  • Architect Solutions: Design and implement scalable, maintainable solutions following our established patterns (Repository-Task-Controller, multi-tenancy, service-oriented design)
  • Maintain Quality: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests using NUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions with 80%+ code coverage targets- own the quality of your code
  • Code Reviews: Review pull requests from team members and AI-generated code, ensuring adherence to architectural patterns and best practices
  • Collaborate on Planning: Work with the team in Azure DevOps to refine stories, estimate effort, and plan sprint deliverables have input in what you build
  • Mentor: Share knowledge with team members and help elevate the team's technical capabilities
  • Support Your Features: Own the operational health of features you build- troubleshoot issues, monitor performance, and participate in on-call rotation

Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core 8.0 with proper authentication, authorization, and error handling
  • Build responsive user interfaces with Vue.js 3, Vuetify 3, and modern JavaScript patterns
  • Design and implement database schemas and migrations using Dapper and FluentMigrator with SQL Server
  • Create and maintain integration connectors using our DVIC (Quartz.NET-based) scheduling framework
  • Implement message-based communication using MassTransit and RabbitMQ
  • Work with Azure cloud services (Blob Storage, App Service, Web PubSub, Azure DevOps)
  • Participate in the migration of legacy AngularJS applications to Vue.js 3
  • Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, etc.) to accelerate development while maintaining quality standards

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills; able to document technical
  • decisions and collaborate effectively
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrable full-stack expertise
  • Strong C# and .NET proficiency: Experience with ASP.NET Core, dependency injection, async/await patterns
  • Modern JavaScript/TypeScript: Solid understanding of ES6+, async programming, and modern frontend frameworks
  • Frontend Framework Experience: Production experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular (Vue.js preferred)
  • SQL Database Expertise: Strong SQL skills, experience with database design, query optimization, and writing efficient SQL queries
  • Docker: Hands-on experience with Docker for containerization, local development environments, and understanding container orchestration
  • API Design: Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs with proper authentication, versioning, and documentation
  • Testing Mindset: Track record of writing unit tests, integration tests, and maintaining high code coverage
  • Version Control: Proficient with Git workflows, pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the stack
  • Ownership Mentality: Track record of seeing features through from conception to production, including post-deployment support and iteration

Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent educational experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience with Vue.js 3 (Composition API or Options API) and Vuetify
  • Experience with micro-ORMs like Dapper or similar lightweight data access libraries
  • Familiarity with database migration tools (FluentMigrator, DbUp, or similar)
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant architecture patterns and considerations
  • Experience with Azure cloud services (App Service, Blob Storage, Azure DevOps)
  • Knowledge of message bus patterns (MassTransit, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus)
  • Experience with service-oriented architecture and inter-service communication patterns
  • Background in document management, workflow systems, or enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Familiarity with Auth0 or similar identity management platforms
  • Experience working with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) in a production environment

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. title: Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Atuamos em parceria com uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial , referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e gestão responsável. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori para atuação temporária até dezembro , com possibilidade de prorrogação .

O profissional participará de projetos e melhorias no módulo SAP SRH (HCM) , com foco em Benefícios (Benefits) , sendo responsável por desenvolver, customizar e manter aplicações Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP , garantindo performance, segurança e excelente experiência do usuário .

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar, adaptar ou estender aplicações SAP Fiori;
  • Atuar com codificação e arquitetura de soluções;
  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicativos SAP Fiori/UI5 voltados a processos de benefícios (adesão, consulta, alteração e cancelamento);
  • Criar e consumir serviços OData via SAP Gateway , integrando as aplicações Fiori aos dados do SRH;
  • Colaborar com consultores funcionais de RH para entendimento das regras de negócio (ex.: infotypes 0167, 0168, 0171);
  • Implementar extensões em aplicativos padrão SAP Fiori (“Meus Benefícios”, “Gerenciar Benefícios”);
  • Garantir conformidade com as diretrizes de UX/UI do SAP Fiori Design Guidelines ;
  • Realizar testes técnicos e funcionais , assegurando performance e segurança dos dados;
  • Publicar e gerenciar aplicativos no Fiori Launchpad (catálogos, grupos e roles);
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, review, retrospectiva) em conjunto com times funcionais, ABAP e de infraestrutura.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Fiori e SAPUI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, XML, controllers, models);
  • Domínio em OData Services (criação, consumo e troubleshooting);
  • Conhecimento em ABAP OO para suporte às integrações com SRH;
  • Vivência com SAP Gateway (SEGW) e configuração de serviços;
  • Experiência com Fiori Launchpad , perfis de acesso (PFCG) e transportes SAP;
  • Domínio das ferramentas SAP Web IDE ou Business Application Studio (BAS) ;
  • Entendimento básico de Fiori Elements, Smart Controls e Theme Designer ;
  • Capacidade de análise de logs e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento dos processos funcionais de Benefícios (BEN) dentro do SRH (planos de saúde, previdência, dependentes, reembolsos);
  • Entendimento dos infotypes 0167, 0168, 0170, 0171 ;
  • Experiência em extensão de aplicativos padrão SAP ;
  • Familiaridade com DevOps, Git, CI/CD e metodologias ágeis ( Scrum ou Kanban );
  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP , CAP ou desenvolvimento em ambientes cloud .

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Software Engineer
description:

We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance. Whether you possess a background in finance, technology, or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.

About the Role : This role involves advising on Murex best practices, contributing to client-site implementations, providing client support, and communicating development needs to the Murex product development team.

Responsibilities :

  • Junior:
  • Advising on Murex best practices in the P&L processes, position management, accounting, hedge accounting and financial reporting.
  • Contributing to client-site MX.3 implementations during the requirements gathering, design, build, test, and deployment phases by participating in workshops, preparing documentation, configuring client requirements and performing quality assurance tests.
  • Providing client support including managing open issues and supporting upgrade activities.
  • Communicating development needs to the Murex product development team.
  • Providing internal and external training.
  • Senior:
  • Advising on Best Practices: Provide guidance on Murex best practices in P&L processes, accounting, hedge accounting, position management, and financial reporting.
  • Client-Site Implementations: Lead all trading designers during an implementation or upgrade; gathering, design, build, test, and deployment phases by participating in workshops, preparing documentation, configuring client requirements, and performing quality assurance tests.
  • Client Support: Manage open issues and support upgrade activities.
  • Communication: Handle the relationship with the product team in one area of expertise and assist in building the product roadmap for the region.
  • Documentation and Training: Provide internal and external documentation and training.

Qualifications :

  • Junior: Ideal candidate is someone with 2-3 years' experience in capital markets technology. The candidate should have a good understanding of accounting principles under IFRS or US GAAP. Knowledge of hedge accounting is a plus. Preferable experience includes supporting either trading, treasury or accounting at banks or other financial institutions or has experience with other fintech vendors. Strong academic background in accounting, engineering or a math-based discipline (math, operations research, statistics etc.). Knowledge of Unix/Linux operating system, SQL, and basic programming is a plus.
  • Senior: The ideal candidate has more than 5 years of experience in capital markets technology. Proven client-facing experience in a support or project implementation role, preferably in trading or risk management solutions in financial institutions. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a master's in financial engineering, Applied Finance/Statistics/Mathematics, or Computational Finance. Systematic problem solver with critical thinking abilities. Strong presenter and effective communicator. Knowledge of Unix/Linux operating systems, SQL, and basic programming.

Required Skills :

  • Good product knowledge/understanding in IRD, CRD, COM, EQD, FXD, FXMM.
  • Good understanding of accounting principles, accounting rules, ledger, and account balances.
  • Good working knowledge of Murex Accounting knowledge.
  • Strong understanding of Back Office functions as well as processing.
  • Strong functional and technical understanding on the settlement instructions.
  • Good knowledge of the different post-trade interactions between the various actors of capital markets including service providers.
  • Good understanding of OSP (open settlement protocol).

Preferred Skills :

  • BS or higher degree in Finance, Mathematics or equivalent.
  • Implementations and upgrades.
  • Test management.
  • Trade life cycle management.
  • Market Data management.
  • Knowledge in SQL (Oracle and/or Sybase) and Unix commands is a plus.
  • Good understanding of Market Risk Management (including VaR, stress-tests, back-testing).
  • Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.
  • Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.
  • Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.
  • Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.
  • Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.
  • Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions.

title: HRBP Coordinator
description:
Position Summary:

The HRBP Coordinator will act as a strategic leader and people manager within the industrial unit, responsible for aligning Human Resources strategies with business objectives. Safety and Organizational Culture

· Act as an ambassador of the safety culture, promoting safe and sustainable behaviors at all levels of the organization.

· Support leadership in building a healthy, ethical, respectful, and inclusive work environment aligned with the company’s values and culture.

· Support leaders in managing the employee lifecycle: recruitment, onboarding, development, performance evaluation, succession, and offboarding.

· Monitor and analyze organizational climate indicators, absenteeism, turnover, and engagement, proposing corrective and preventive actions.

· Conduct climate surveys and coordinate action plans focused on continuous improvement of the work environment.

· Encourage active listening and open dialogue between employees and leadership.

Leadership Consulting and Support

· Be a trusted advisor to managers, providing strategic and tactical support on people management topics.

· Support change management processes, internal communication, organizational development, and conflict resolution.

· Promote consistent application of HR policies and guidelines, ensuring alignment with organizational strategies.

HR Metrics and Process Management

· Monitor and analyze Human Resources KPIs, proposing continuous improvements in processes and policies.

· Ensure compliance with labor legislation, internal policies, and occupational safety guidelines.

· Support internal and external audits, ensuring adherence to best practices and legal requirements.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

· Promote actions that strengthen diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

· Support programs focused on gender, race, people with disabilities (PWD), and other underrepresented groups, contributing to a fair and representative environment.

Union Relations and Labor Conflict Management

· Act as a liaison with local unions, participating in collective bargaining and ensuring compliance with agreed terms.

· Manage labor conflicts, conducting mediation processes and promoting collaborative solutions.

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Law, Economics, or related fields.

Postgraduate specialization in related areas is desirable.

English B2 level required (Conversation needed)

Solid generalist HR experience, including Compensation and Benefits, Payroll, Recruitment and Selection, Training and People Development, Corporate HR Projects, Labor Negotiations, and Union Relations.

title: Video Ad Copywriter - Paid Media & AI-Driven Creative
description:
About the Role

Property Leads is a fast-growing real estate lead generation and data company. We’re looking for a Paid Media Ad Copywriter who can craft high-performing copy across multiple digital channels. This role blends creative storytelling with performance marketing expertise , you’ll write, test, and optimize ad copy that drives engagement and lead generation.

You’ll collaborate closely with the team to develop data-driven ad messaging that scales across platforms. If you love combining words, metrics, and AI tools to create ads that convert — this role is for you.

Responsibilities Copywriting for Performance
  • Write and test compelling copy for paid ads across Meta, TikTok, Google, and YouTube .
  • Craft headlines, primary text, CTAs, scripts , and short-form hooks that align with each platform’s audience behavior.
  • Adapt messaging for various funnel stages (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU) to optimize conversions.
  • Collaborate with designers and video editors to align visuals and copy for cohesive creative execution.
Creative Strategy & Optimization
  • Develop multiple copy variations for A/B testing and analyze performance metrics like CTR, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rate .
  • Use data insights and feedback from the Paid Media team to refine messaging and improve outcomes.
  • Research competitors, market trends, and ad libraries to identify new creative angles.
  • Maintain an organized library of top-performing headlines, hooks, and frameworks.
AI & Automation
  • Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Jasper, Copy.ai, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, or Runway to assist in scriptwriting, ideation, and ad copy generation.
  • Experiment with AI-driven testing to quickly iterate and scale winning copy.
Collaboration & Workflow
  • Work with the Creative, Media Buying, and Strategy teams to ensure copy aligns with campaign goals.
  • Meet deadlines for consistent delivery of new ad variations.
  • Take initiative in creative brainstorming sessions and performance reviews.
Expected Outcomes
  • Increased ad engagement and click-through rates (CTR).
  • Improved conversion rates and reduced cost per acquisition (CPA).
  • Faster creative testing cycles through AI and automation.
  • Consistent production of fresh, high-performing copy variants.
Qualifications Required
  • 3–5 years of experience writing copy for paid media (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or Google).
  • Strong understanding of performance metrics (CTR, CPA, ROAS, etc.) and how copy impacts them.
  • Proven track record in direct response, lead generation, or performance marketing .
  • Excellent command of English , with attention to detail and tone adaptation.
  • Experience using AI tools to ideate or generate ad concepts and scripts.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred
  • Experience in real estate, e-commerce, or lead generation industries.
  • Familiarity with UGC-style scripting and short-form video ad copy.
  • Basic understanding of media buying and campaign structure.
  • Knowledge of AI-driven creative workflows (text-to-video, voiceovers, etc.).
Benefits
  • Competitive compensation
  • 100% remote work-from-anywhere environment
  • Collaborative, innovative culture that values data, creativity, and growth

description:
Vem pra OMNIA!

Missão:

Responsável por apoiar o Diretor de Operações na elaboração, implementação e consolidação do modelo operacional dos data centers da Omnia, garantindo padrões de excelência em disponibilidade, segurança e eficiência.

Atua como elo entre a engenharia do site, manutenção, segurança e operações, assegurando que processos, políticas e equipes estejam alinhados à estratégia corporativa e às melhores práticas internacionais do setor de infraestrutura crítica.

Atribuições:

  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e planos operacionais para operação, manutenção e segurança dos data centers.
  • Apoiar o Diretor de Operações na estruturação da equipe técnica, participando ativamente da definição de cargos, responsabilidades e contratações.
  • Liderar a padronização de processos e indicadores (KPIs) operacionais, de manutenção e sustentabilidade.
  • Coordenar e supervisionar as rotinas de operação, engenharia e manutenção, garantindo conformidade com normas (TIA-942, ASHRAE, ABNT, NFPA) e políticas internas.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de contingência, continuidade e resposta a incidentes.
  • Estabelecer interface técnica com as áreas de engenharia, projetos, TI, segurança e facilities, promovendo integração e melhoria contínua.
  • Participar da elaboração do budget operacional e propor melhorias de eficiência energética e de custos (OPEX).
  • Supervisionar contratos de fornecedores, garantindo SLA, conformidade técnica e otimização de desempenho.
  • Coordenar auditorias internas e externas, certificações e programas de qualidade e sustentabilidade.
  • Garantir a documentação técnica, planos de manutenção, relatórios e histórico de ativos de acordo com o sistema de gestão adotado.
  • Atuar como ponto focal junto a clientes e parceiros em temas operacionais, com postura técnica e orientada à excelência em atendimento.

Experiências:

  • Âmbito inicial: Estruturação da operação do primeiro site greenfield, com foco em políticas, procedimentos e processos técnicos de operação e manutenção.
  • Equipe futura: Responsável por apoiar o Diretor de Operações na definição e contratação da equipe operacional completa no primeiro ciclo de 12 meses.
  • Escopo técnico: Governança sobre os sistemas elétricos, mecânicos e de segurança (MEP) em ambientes de missão crítica, garantindo readiness para comissionamento e RFS.

Conhecimentos necessários:

  • Idiomas: Inglês técnico (fluente), desejável espanhol intermediário.

title: Analista Fiscal Sênior
description:
Quem somos?

A primeira unidade da AMAGGI, a Sementes Maggi, foi inaugurada em 1977 na cidade de São Miguel do Iguaçu, no Paraná. Dois anos depois, em 1979, tiveram início as atividades em Mato Grosso, com a aquisição de uma fazenda no município de Itiquira.

Desde então, a empresa tem ampliado suas unidades e áreas de negócios, expandindo a atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Com sede em Cuiabá (MT), é hoje a maior companhia brasileira na cadeia de grãos e fibras do país e está presente também na China, Argentina, Paraguai, Holanda, Noruega, Singapura e Suíça.

Além disso, desde 1997 contribui para o desenvolvimento local e humano nas comunidades onde atua, colocando-se como parceira no desenvolvimento sustentável dessas localidades por meio da Fundação André e Lucia Maggi.

Sobre a vaga

Atribuições:

  • Atuará na célula de Apuração dos Impostos Estaduais;
  • Apuração de ICMS;
  • Entrega de obrigações acessórias estaduais;
  • Entre outros.

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Graduação Completa em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Experiência na parte fiscal ou tributária;
  • Conhecimento em ICMS, especialmente na legislação de Mato Grosso;
  • Passagem por empresas do ramo do agronegócio será um grande diferencial.

*Nossas oportunidades são abertas para todos os profissionais, sem distinção de raça, cor, gênero, idade, crença e deficiência (PCD)*

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com cobertura ao vivo de eventos esportivos e uso de IA em tempo real (ex: geração de conteúdo automático com base em estatísticas do jogo);

  • Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Sobre a vaga

Na M. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem-estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoa é valorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem!

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.

Alimentar e inspirar as pessoas, transformando sonhos em realidade

Esse é o propósito que nos inspira e faz com que sejamos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil! Reconhecida como líder nacional nos mercados de massas e biscoitos, estamos entre as maiores companhias do mundo nesses segmentos. Com quase sete décadas de existência, marcamos presença em todo o País com marcas regionais, nacionais e, agora, no Uruguai, nossa primeira aquisição internacional! Com um amplo portfólio de produtos que são sinônimos de sabor e qualidade, temos uma relação de confiança e respeito com consumidores de vários perfis.

Atuamos nos seguintes segmentos: Biscoitos de trigo e arroz; massas de trigo e milho; farinhas e farelos de trigo; misturas para bolos; margarinas e cremes vegetais; bolos; snacks de milho e trigo; torradas; biscoitos cobertos de chocolate; pasta de amendoim; temperos e chocolates; molhos, granolas; cookies; panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

A partir da nossa sede, localizada na cidade de Eusébio, no Ceará, adotamos uma estratégia bem sucedida de construção e aquisição de novas indústrias. Possuímos um moderno parque industrial, com equipamentos de última geração, seguindo os mais rigorosos padrões de qualidade na produção de alimentos e operando com um modelo de integração vertical, que permite a produção de nossas mais importantes matérias-primas.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e ao bem comum, considerando a diversidade como o elemento mais importante para geração de resultados e mudanças significativas. Todas as nossas oportunidades são acessíveis a pessoas com deficiência, e valorizamos a autenticidade e o potencial de cada talento.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
O Engenheiro de Dados Sênior é um líder técnico estratégico, especializado em projetar e gerenciar sistemas de dados complexos, escaláveis e inteligentes. Ele atua como arquiteto, mentor e solucionador de problemas críticos, garantindo qualidade, performance e integridade dos dados, além de impulsionar a aplicação de inteligência artificial generativa e aprendizagem profunda para extração de insights avançados.

Projetar e implementar sistemas de dados complexos e escaláveis, utilizando tecnologias como cloud computing, big data, streaming e machine learning e IA definindo estratégias de armazenamento, processamento e análise de dados. Incorporar Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) e bancos vetoriais para processamento inteligente de dados.

Guiar e inspirar a equipe de engenharia de dados, compartilhando conhecimento, definindo padrões e melhores práticas, e promovendo o crescimento técnico da equipe.

Identificar e resolver problemas complexos relacionados a sistemas de dados, arquitetura, performance e escalabilidade, utilizando ferramentas de monitoramento, análise de logs e depuração de código.

Criar e implementar soluções inovadoras para otimizar os sistemas de dados, utilizando tecnologias emergentes, como machine learning, data lake, streaming de dados em tempo real e big data analytics.

Comunicar soluções técnicas de forma clara e concisa para stakeholders, gestores, desenvolvedores e outras áreas, influenciando decisões estratégicas e contribuindo para o alinhamento da estratégia de dados com os objetivos da empresa.

Domínio profundo de linguagens de programação Python, além de ferramentas de processamento de dados como Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink ou equivalentes.

Conhecimento em LLMs, ajuste fino de modelos de IA e uso de RAG para melhorar eficiência na busca e recuperação de informações. Domínio dos serviços do Amazon Bedrock e/ou Azure OpenAI.

Experiência com arquitetura de sistemas de dados, big data (Hadoop, Hive, HBase), streaming (Kafka, Kinesis) e bancos de dados (SQL, NoSQL).

Conhecimento avançado de ferramentas de modelagem de dados, processamento de dados e visualização de dados, como SQL, NoSQL, Tableau, Power BI, etc.

Conhecimento avançado em construção de Data Lake e Data Warehouse usando ferramentas como AWS Athena, AWS Redshift, AWS S3, AWS Glue, Airbyte, DBT e Postgres.

Compreensão profunda de conceitos de machine learning e aplicacão de técnicas de machine learning em sistemas de dados.

Habilidades de comunicação clara e eficaz, tanto verbal como escrita, para se comunicar com diferentes públicos (técnicos e não técnicos).

Liderança natural e capacidade de inspirar e motivar equipes, compartilhando conhecimento e promovendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo.

Pensamento estratégico e visão crítica para tomar decisões importantes, avaliar riscos e definir prioridades.

Adaptabilidade para lidar com avanços em inteligência artificial, aprendizado profundo e processamento vetorial de dados.

Proatividade e capacidade de identificar problemas e oportunidades, propondo soluções inovadoras e contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe e da empresa.

Membros da Equipe: Interação diária com os membros da equipe

Stakeholders: Contato estreito com os líderes das áreas demandantes e stakeholders dos projetos

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins.

Experiência comprovada (mais de 3 anos) em engenharia de dados.

Inglês técnico para leitura, escrita e comunicação profissional.

Job Summary:

The Cloud Automation Engineer will be part of the database engineering team accountable for developing platform implementation standards to drive operational excellence for our on-premise and Cloud database platforms. This role will require a strong focus on CI/CD and Cloud native automation tools to facilitate database deployments and administration. This person is tasked with solving difficult and moderately complex problems. The candidate will be expected to function in an advisory capacity. The Cloud Automation Engineer is a senior individual contributor who may contribute to the development of other junior level professionals.

•Function as a SME for automation tooling in support of our database infrastructure in AWS, GCP and other Cloud environments as needed.

•Develop/modify Jenkins pipelines following industry best practices and security standards and suggest improvements.

•Develop/modify Terraform code to deploy and/or administer our hybrid Cloud implementations.

•Use Bitbucket/Git for code repository.

•Develop various automated processes utilizing tools such as python,json, native Cloud cli and serverless offerings such as AWS Lambda.

•Contributes to the planning, architecture, design, implementation, standards creation, maintenance, and support of open-source database offerings as needed within a complex Hybrid Cloud systems environment.

•Responsible for enhancements to standards documentation and adhering to change management policies while promoting code deployment.

•Adhere to Team Agile practices using the defined Agile tool.

•Lead and/or participate in Proof-of-Concept efforts for new automation and database technologies.

•Be an escalation point for operational support needs related to automation tooling.

•Provide RCA for critical issues in a timely manner.

•Active, enthusiastic participation in efforts to improve our platforms as part of a collaborative team.

•Effectively and clearly communicate, both verbally and in writing, to colleagues at all organizational levels.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Education –Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field of work or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.

Experience –

•7+ years of progressive experience in CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Terraform, Git.

•3+ years of hands-on experience with deploying/managing AWS Cloud infrastructure. Experience with AWS Aurora MySQL/Postgres, RDS Oracle/SQL Server and DynamoDB is a bonus.

•3+ years of hands-on experience in other relevant automation tooling.

Technical Skills and Knowledge:

•Experience with Cloud monitoring tools such as AWS Cloudwatch/CloudTrail/Performance Insights/Events and Google Operations/Query Insights

•Demonstrated hands on experience creating and managing database/infrastructure deployments and modifications using Terraform.

•Demonstrated hands on experience and knowledge of code repository usage and structure using tools such as Bitbucket(preferred) and Git.

•Demonstrated hands on experience and knowledge of CI/CD pipeline tools such as Jenkins(preferred), Rundeck, Octopus etc.

•General knowledge of database design and related architecture.

•Advanced knowledge and understanding of structured analysis and technical design techniques.

•Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.

•Ability to learn new technologies in a rapidly evolving Cloud environment.

•Experience as part of a team executing large-scale projects from conception through implementation.

•Effective verbal and written communication skills for providing information to clients, vendors, senior management, and staff.

•Ability to mentor teams, share knowledge, and mentor junior database staff.

Hot Skills

•CI/CD Automation tooling expertise – Terraform, Jenkins, Git, etc.

•Python, Linux shell, json, html, other tools.
