title: Arquiteto de Software - TOGAF - Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades Principais

  • Atuar desde a fase de Discovery , conduzindo o levantamento técnico do landscape de aplicações, integrações, bases de dados e infraestrutura (camadas C e D do TOGAF).
  • Participar ativamente do MVP N0 , traduzindo princípios de arquitetura corporativa em modelos conceituais tecnológicos (diagramas C4, ArchiMate, ou equivalentes).
  • Liderar o detalhamento técnico no MVP N1 , estruturando o plano de execução, priorização de sprints e definição de dependências técnicas.
  • Garantir que as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas aos princípios e padrões definidos pelo modelo TOGAF e pela Softtek.
  • Apoiar a definição do roadmap tecnológico e do plano de evolução de aplicações, dados e integrações.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para os squads de implementação, garantindo consistência, performance e compliance das soluções.
  • Produzir documentação e apresentações técnicas que conectem o desenho arquitetural à visão de negócio e às metas do projeto.
  • Apoiar a Softtek e o cliente na implantação de práticas de governança de arquitetura e controle de mudanças.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência mínima de 8 a 12 anos em arquitetura de software corporativo, com histórico de atuação em projetos complexos de integração e transformação digital.
  • Domínio de padrões de arquitetura distribuída , APIs, microsserviços, mensageria, segurança (OAuth2, JWT, OpenID Connect), observabilidade e cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Forte experiência em integração de sistemas legados e ambientes híbridos (on-prem + cloud) .
  • Capacidade comprovada de desenhar e validar arquiteturas de referência alinhadas a frameworks corporativos (TOGAF, IT4IT, Zachman).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de modelagem e documentação técnica (Draw.io, Lucidchart, ArchiMate, Enterprise Architect, Confluence).
  • Conhecimento de linguagens e frameworks modernos (Java, .NET Core, Python, Node.js, Spring Boot, Kafka, RESTful APIs).
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible ou similares).
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ciclos iterativos de arquitetura .


Detalhes da Contratação

  • Modelo remoto
  • Regime PJ – Alocação temporário 3 meses, podendo prorrogar para até 9 meses.



A Softtek valoriza a diversidade e inclusão em sua força de trabalho. A empresa tem uma equipe global com pessoas de diferentes origens e culturas, o que torna o ambiente de trabalho mais rico e interessante. Independentemente da sua, etnia, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, credo ou convicção política, o que importa são as suas competências e habilidades para fazer acontecer


Os Softtekians são seres humanos talentosos e auto-determinados que se consideram pessoas loucamente incríveis! Venha fazer parte desse time!!!


Quer saber mais? Acesse:


Sobre a Softtek : Fundada em 1982, a Softtek é uma fornecedora global de soluções de TI orientadas a processos com 30 escritórios na América do Norte, América Latina, Europa e Ásia. Com 15 centros de entrega global nos EUA, México, China, Brasil, Argentina, Costa Rica, Espanha, Hungria e Índia, a Softtek ajuda a melhorar e produzir resultados previsíveis para corporações de primeira linha em mais de 20 países. A Softtek é a criadora e líder da indústria nearshore.


Para obter mais informações sobre o que fazemos, quem somos e oportunidades de carreira, visite

@Softtek no Twitter e seja nosso fã no Facebook

Caso se candidate para essa vaga seus dados ficarão armazenados em nosso banco de dados, atendendo a privacidade de dados conforme à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados, lei nº 13.

  • Apoiar a Softtek e o cliente na implantação de práticas de governança de arquitetura e controle de mudanças.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Who We Are:


AdMaxTech is a leading mobile app user acquisition agency, working directly with top-tier advertisers across various app verticals. Our team brings together expertise from global tech giants and world-class performance marketing agencies.


Why Join Us:

  • Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely from your preferred location.
  • Be part of a fast-paced, results-driven environment in the booming mobile advertising industry.
  • The global mobile advertising market exceeded $280 billion in 2022 and is projected to reach $353 billion by 2025 — a 26% growth opportunity you can be part of.
  • Join a diverse, international team with a strong focus on collaboration, growth, and performance.


Your Role:

As a Business Development Manager, you will play a crucial role in expanding our advertiser partnerships and driving revenue growth. Your main responsibilities include:

✔ Research and identify the right decision-makers within potential advertiser organizations.

✔ Conduct pitch meetings and negotiations with prospective clients, aiming to close new deals.

✔ Collaborate closely with our internal teams to ensure a smooth onboarding process for new clients.

✔ Maintain up-to-date records and follow-up activities in our internal tracking system.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong research and communication skills.
  • Proven experience in business development, sales, or account management, preferably in digital marketing, mobile apps, or ad-tech.
  • Self-driven, organized, and result-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.


Why It’s Exciting:

The mobile app industry is growing fast — so are we. This is your opportunity to make a direct impact, contribute to our success, and grow your career alongside experienced professionals.


*AdMaxTech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Brazil -Front-end Developer
description:
In Short

Arke is actively searching for a qualified Front-end developer in Brazil. You'll join our dynamic team, collaborating directly with our Brazil Country Head and fellow developers to create intuitive, appealing, and performant web applications for our clients. We’re looking for someone passionate about crafting outstanding user experiences and eager to stay current with evolving digital technologies.


Code samples are required.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with team members and clients to design and implement high-quality solutions based on technical and business requirements.
  • Use modern development standards and tools to create software applications that delight users.
  • Produce detailed documentation, test plans, and maintain well-documented, clean, and efficient code.
  • Foster trusted partnerships with coworkers and clients.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to explore innovative UI solutions.
  • Develop tested and documented TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Build responsive and cross-browser compatible applications optimized for desktop and mobile.
  • Adhere strictly to branding guidelines and UX standards.
  • Maintain positive and productive working relationships with stakeholders, peers, and management.


What We’d Love to See

  • 2–4 years of professional front-end development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.
  • Proven professional experience using React.
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and branch strategies.
  • Experience with browser compatibility testing and debugging
  • Strong understanding of UI design principles and layout aesthetics.
  • Basic knowledge of SEO best practices.
  • Intermediate spoken English, fluent in written English.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.
  • Have excellent analytical and multitasking skills.
  • Be reliable and dependable, consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.


Nice to have

  • Experience with Next.js.
  • Familiarity with additional front-end frameworks.
  • Experience with content management systems (CMS).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or related fields.


Who We Are

Arke is a full-service experience design and technology consultancy that believes in providing more – much more. We change the way brands approach digital transformation and create defining moments to better connect brands with their customers. Arke’s core values are the soul of who we are and shape everything we do. We are authentically unique, operate with high standards, and love what we do.

title: Masters / PHD In Physics
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Physics with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Sobre a vaga


A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que buscamos?

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados com sólida experiência em Informática IDMC , responsável por projetar, construir e manter sistemas que coletam, processam e armazenam grandes volumes de dados para uso estratégico nas empresas. Ele garante que os dados estejam acessíveis, organizados e prontos para análise. PROJETO DE 6 MESES (foco em implantação IDMC).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Informatica IDMC (instalação, configuração, tuning e Secure Agents);
  • Conhecimento em ETL/ELT e integração de dados em ambientes híbridos;
  • Domínio em Python e SQL;
  • Familiaridade com Scala, Spark, Kafka e plataformas como Hadoop;
  • Experiência com PostgreSQL, MongoDB e BigQuery;
  • Vivência com AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud;
  • Conhecimento em Linux, rede e segurança de dados (criptografia, certificados SSL, LGPD);
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Desejável:

  • Certificações em engenharia de dados, cloud computing e big data;
  • Práticas de CI/CD e versionamento (Git).



Vaga Hibrida para a região de SP (1x na semana no presencial) e as demais regiões remoto e CLT

Vaga por tempo determinado - 6 meses



O que oferecemos?

· Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Auxílio creche;

· Parceria com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

· Seguro de Vida;

· Seguro de Vida;

· WellHub;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Analista de Research & Insights JR - Freela
description:

  • Realizar análises de conversas em redes sociais utilizando ferramentas de social listening (Sprinklr);

  • Vivência com análise de dados qualitativos e quantitativos em ambiente digital;

  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas (planejamento, conteúdo, mídia, BI, etc.).

title: SDR (Vendedor)  Pleno
description:
Na V4 Company, acreditamos que crescimento não acontece por acaso, e sim por estratégia. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que desafiam o mercado e entregam resultados de verdade, conectando performance e inovação.


Nosso ambiente de trabalho:


  • Transparência total: somos diretos e objetivos.
  • Trabalho em equipe: ninguém cresce sozinho.
  • Autonomia com responsabilidade: tomamos decisões e assumimos a execução.


Se você quer fazer parte de uma equipe que pensa grande e age rápido, essa vaga é para você!


Na V4 Company, os profissionais de Pré-Vendas (SDR/BDR) são responsáveis por abrir portas. Você será peça-chave na qualificação de leads e na geração de oportunidades para nossos Consultores Comerciais, garantindo um funil saudável, previsível e com alta conversão.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Realizar abordagens outbound (ligações, e-mails, social selling);
  • Qualificar leads com base nos critérios da V4 (BANT, GPCT ou similares);
  • Agendar reuniões para os consultores de vendas;
  • Alimentar o CRM com informações estratégicas sobre os leads;
  • Trabalhar com metas de cadência, conversão e reuniões agendadas;
  • Colaborar com os times de Marketing e Vendas para refinar a estratégia.


O que buscamos em você:


Para Júnior:


  • Vontade de aprender e iniciar na área comercial;
  • Boa comunicação e proatividade;
  • Facilidade com ferramentas digitais e organização.


Para Pleno:


  • Experiência prévia como SDR ou BDR;
  • Domínio básico de frameworks de qualificação;
  • Boa gestão de tempo e processos comerciais.


Para Sênior:


  • Histórico consistente de performance em geração de oportunidades;
  • Capacidade de liderar processos e melhorar cadências;
  • Olhar estratégico sobre dados e indicadores de conversão;
  • Capacidade de contribuir na formação de novos talentos.


Requisitos gerais:


  • Disponibilidade para trabalho em modelo presencial, híbrido ou remoto (dependendo da operação);
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Foco em metas e resultados;
  • Vontade genuína de crescer com performance.


Diferenciais:


  • Ter trabalhado em agências, consultorias ou empresas de performance digital;
  • Conhecimento prévio de CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similares);
  • Participação em programas de formação em vendas (G4 Sales, Reev, etc).


O que oferecemos:


  • Acesso aos cursos da Staage.
  • Onhappy - benefício corporativo de viagens a lazer.
  • Desconto na matrícula de graduação e pós-graduação da Wyden.
  • Starbem - uma plataforma de bem-estar com psicólogos, nutricionistas e mais 16 especialidades
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional.
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo e aprendizado constante.
  • Gestão meritocrática.
  • Possibilidade de sociedade baseada no desempenho e alinhamento cultural com o negócio.

title: ESPECIALISTA PRODUCT DESIGNER I
description:

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
Company Description

LAB Tech Analytics is a dynamic and forward-thinking small company dedicated to revolutionizing data-driven solutions. We empower businesses to unlock the true potential of their data assets with our comprehensive suite of services. From our top-notch data recruitment and training hub to our cutting-edge data products and services, we provide end-to-end solutions for every stage of the data lifecycle. Our expert team combines technical excellence with deep industry knowledge to deliver actionable insights, advanced analytics, robust data infrastructure, and strategic guidance.


Role Description

This is a contract remote role for a Software Engineer Intern. The Software Engineer Intern will be responsible for developing, testing, and maintaining software applications, assisting in the design and implementation of new features, and collaborating with the engineering team to improve existing systems. The intern will also participate in code reviews, write clear and efficient code, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.


Qualifications

  • Experience in programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, C++)
  • Understanding of software development methodologies and tools
  • Interest in learning and both front-end and back-end development
  • Familiarity with databases and data structures
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Brazilian Portuguese
  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience with data analytics and machine learning is a plus

title: Audio Transcription Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


Job Title: Audio Transcription Specialist (Language: Portuguese, Location: Portugal)


About The Role:

We are seeking detail-oriented and dedicated professionals with hands-on experience in audio transcription and quality assurance . The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurately converting audio content into written text, maintaining high standards of accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen carefully to audio recordings and transcribe them into clear, accurate, and grammatically correct text .
  • Identify and correct transcription errors , ensuring proper spelling, punctuation, and formatting.
  • Handle different accents, speech clarity levels, and background noises with attention to detail.
  • Tag and label transcriptions as per project guidelines.
  • Review, proofread, and edit transcripts for quality, accuracy, and completeness .
  • Follow client-specific formatting and delivery instructions.
  • Work closely with project leads and QA teams to meet daily quality and productivity targets .
  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.
  • Excellent command of English (or other project-specific language) with strong grammar and listening skills.
  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines .
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects .
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks .
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.



If Interested, kindly send your resume at:

title: Advogado associado
description:
Vaga: Advogado(a) Pleno – Direito Bancário / CEF

Modalidade: Home Office

Escritório: Coelho e Gavioli – Advogados Associados

Sobre a vaga

O escritório Coelho e Gavioli – Advogados Associados está em busca de um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno com experiência em Direito Bancário , especialmente em demandas envolvendo a Caixa Econômica Federal (CEF) .

O(a) profissional atuará no contencioso cível bancário, com foco em estratégia, análise processual e condução de ações de média complexidade.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerir e conduzir processos judiciais da CEF , assegurando qualidade técnica e eficiência nos resultados;
  • Elaborar petições, relatórios e peças processuais em diferentes fases processuais;
  • Realizar análises de risco e propostas de acordo , com visão estratégica e foco em resultados;
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e treinamentos jurídicos internos ;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de prazos e a manutenção dos padrões de qualidade do escritório.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Direito e inscrição ativa na OAB ;
  • Experiência comprovada em Direito Bancário , preferencialmente com casos envolvendo a Caixa Econômica Federal ;
  • Capacidade analítica, senso de responsabilidade e boa comunicação escrita;
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com facilidade para trabalho remoto e em equipe.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em contencioso de massa bancário ;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas jurídicos como CPJ , PJe e plataformas de bancos públicos.

title: Capital Agents
description:
We’re Expanding Our Global Capital Agent Network – Join Magnum Equities as an Independent Capital Agent


Remote | Global | Commission-Based | #PrivateEquity #CapitalRaising #InvestmentOpportunities #CapitalAgent #Agent #Broker #InvestmentBanker #PrivateMarkets #VentureCapital #Entrepreneurship


Are you a capital introducer, private banker, independent dealmaker, ultra-networker, or connected investment professional looking to monetize your network?


Magnum is seeking experienced Capital Agents to join our global sourcing network. These independent agents will facilitate capital to Magnum Equities and earn 2% commission on successfully funded partnership capital placements, from fiat currency to crypto currency.


Capital Agent – Independent Investment Sourcing Partner


Location: Global | Remote

Full | Part-time or Side gig with your current job


Industry: You can be of any industry sector background, early/mid/or late in your career, having a capital network of partnership investment prospects that desire high ROI via profit share in Magnum’s global real estate and business equities assets growth forward, and large-scale social impact.


Commission: 2% of Capital Raised


About Magnum Equities


Magnum is foremost a mass capital investment partnership platform, capital raise platform for SME's, and mass social impact/empowerment powerhouse. Magnum's main pillars: Real Estate Assets Partners | Tech/Business Equity Partners | Precious Metals | Sukuk (Marabaha) enabling Shariah compliant capital placement investment from micro to macro capital partners, via “Magnum Equities Partnership Tokenization". Enabling globally democratized - low barrier to entry (min 50 Euros/token) - investment, empowering individuals to large institutional capital placement participation in Magnum’s global portfolio rather than being limited to only a specific single asset, optimizing short/medium/long term (3-5yrs), ROI (3X/5X/10X/100X/2500X+), and abatement of any singular asset downside. Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Micro to Macro partnerships via fractional partnership profit share tokenization on blockchain via our RWA/PropTech blockchain/fintech partner portal.


Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment


What We Offer


  • Attractive transparent commission model - Unique Agent link to use | Earnings wallet
  • Leverage Magnum’s professionally curated pitch decks, site resources etc
  • Flexible, remote-first role – ideal for global professionals
  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance
  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management


*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.


This mass individual empowerment and expansive social impact integration is a purposeful and very important component to us at Magnum, in keeping with our 125yr tradition, where democratized opportunity for all, at every socio-economic level, every geo-location in developed and under-developed nations, can raise the ‘economic base of the societal pyramid’ in every region. Where capitalism can co-exist without displacement, with equality, dignity, respect, levelling the contentious playing field between the “have’s and the have not’s”.


Commission Example (2% on capital intake from each partner capital placement with Magnum)


Raise 1,000 EU  Earn 20 EU- Micro partners/investors (global individuals)


Raise $100,000 EU  Earn 2,000 EU – Individuals | HNW | Small fund portfolios


Raise 5M EU  Earn 100,000 EU – UHNW | Single/Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios


Raise 10M EU  Earn 200,000 EU - UHNW | Single/Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios | Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds etc.

Graduação em curso de nível superior na área de TI;

Experiência com codificação de aplicações C#.NET, ASP.NET;

• MCSA: Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate: Web Applications;

Experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos baseados em Metodologia Ágil, adotando requisitos ágeis e histórias do usuário.

description:
Buscamos parceiros comerciais para levar para sua rede de clientes a oferta dos produtos e serviços da Nord Investimentos .


Somos hoje a maior casa de research independente do país e também temos uma das principais Consultorias de Investimentos , sendo reconhecida como Top Consultoria na XP, BTG e Avenue.

title: GIS Python Developer
description:
GIS Python Developer (QA/QC Automation – ArcGIS Workflow Manager)

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Full-Time / Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a GIS Python Developer to design, develop, and implement automated Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) processes for spatial data. The role involves writing Python scripts (primarily using ArcPy or the ArcGIS API for Python ) and integrating them into Esri’s ArcGIS Workflow Manager to streamline and automate GIS data validation across teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop QA/QC Scripts:
  • Create and maintain Python scripts to automatically identify and correct spatial data issues such as:
  • Missing or invalid geometry
  • Polygon overlaps or gaps
  • Attribute inconsistencies
  • Coordinate system mismatches
  • Topology and connectivity errors (e.g., roads not connecting properly)


  • Integrate with ArcGIS Workflow Manager:
  • Configure and embed QA/QC scripts as automated steps within ArcGIS Workflow Manager task sequences, enabling:
  • Automatic validation after data edits or updates
  • Flagging and reporting of errors for correction
  • Consistent enforcement of spatial data quality standards


  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance:
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.


  • Collaborate Across Teams:
  • Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics , or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation .
  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies , including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise , and ArcGIS Workflow Manager .
  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python .
  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems .
  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.
  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.
  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.


What You’ll Achieve

You’ll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

Vaga: Desenvolvedor Power APPs

Local: Home Office


Descrição da vaga:


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Power Apps para integrar nosso time e atuar no desenvolvimento e implantação de soluções voltadas à digitalização de processos de trabalho. Se você possui experiência com ferramentas low-code, programação backend e frontend, além de familiaridade com UX e computação em nuvem, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e implementar aplicativos para a digitalização de processos corporativos.
  • Criar aplicações com foco em interfaces de usuário (páginas web, SharePoint, chatbots, etc.).
  • Desenvolver aplicativos para integração de dados provenientes de diferentes fontes, como bancos de dados e ferramentas de e-mail.
  • Construir soluções utilizando ferramentas/linguagens como Power Apps, ASP, Java, Python, JavaScript, AngularJS, SharePoint, entre outras.
  • Desenvolver funcionalidades que melhorem a experiência do usuário, aplicando conceitos de UX e UX Writing.
  • Trabalhar em projetos que utilizem computação em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou outras plataformas).
  • Participar do mapeamento de processos como diferencial para o desenvolvimento das soluções.


Requisitos:


  • Graduação Completa ou Cursando na área de TI;
  • Experiência em programação backend (Java, Python, etc.).
  • Experiência em programação frontend (JavaScript, CSS, HTML5).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de banco de dados, como SQL, Oracle e Pentaho.
  • Experiência com ferramentas low-code, especialmente Microsoft Power Apps.
  • Conhecimento em computação em nuvem (Azure, AWS, entre outros).
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em UX e UX Writing.
  • Familiaridade com o desenvolvimento de soluções integradas e digitais.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Experiência com mapeamento de processos.



O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Audio Transcribers
description:
We’re Hiring: Freelance Transcribers


We are looking for experienced and detail-oriented freelance transcribers to join our team for an exciting transcription project. The task involves converting non-English audio files (primarily podcast episodes) into accurate written text in accordance with the provided project guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen to and transcribe audio files with high accuracy and attention to detail
  • Follow specific formatting and linguistic guidelines
  • Ensure timely delivery of assigned tasks


Requirements:

✅ Prior experience in transcription (especially non-English content)

✅ Excellent listening and language skills in the target language

✅ Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

✅ Ability to meet deadlines

title: Bolsista Graduado - Grupo Boticário - UX - Produtos Digitais da Indústria | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa.

O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.


Projeto: UX - Produtos Digitais da Indústria


Sobre a Oportunidade:


Inovação e desenvolvimento são parte do DNA do Grupo Boticário, e você pode fazer parte de evolução. Estamos em busca de um talento colaborativo e analítico para atuar na criação de um sistema inédito de governança e acompanhamento dos programas de Desenvolvimento e Capacitação Industrial.

O projeto visa centralizar informações, automatizar processos e otimizar a alocação de mão de obra, trazendo mais eficiência, agilidade e inteligência à gestão fabril.

Se você quer contribuir com soluções que conectam tecnologia, pessoas e resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.


Formação Acadêmica: Design ou áreas correlatas


Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolver interfaces e fluxos de usuário intuitivos e eficazes, seguindo as melhores práticas de UX e os padrões de design do Grupo Boticário;
  • Colaborar com designers de produto e engenheiros na adoção, uso e documentação dos componentes;
  • Prototipar e conduzir testes de usabilidade para validar as soluções de design e aprimorar a experiência do usuário;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento, garantindo a implementação adequada e a consistência visual das interfaces;
  • Produzir e manter a documentação de design, incluindo guias de estilo e especificações técnicas;
  • Apresentar soluções de design e coletar feedback de stakeholders para promover melhorias contínuas



Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Formação em Design ou áreas correlatas, com experiência em UX para aplicações web ou mobile;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design como Figma ou similares;
  • Habilidades de comunicação;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de produto;
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes multifuncionais, multilíngues e colaborativos, com autonomia;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e trabalho em squads multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimento sólido em princípios de design de interação, usabilidade e acessibilidade.
  • Conhecimento sobre Product Designer, aplicando conceitos de Arquitetura de Informação, Visual, UX Writing, Pesquisa qualitativa e quantitativa, além de métodos de facilitação;


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em pesquisa com usuários e testes de usabilidade;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento básico de React.


Soft Skills:

  • Proatividade e iniciativa para resolver problemas e buscar soluções inovadoras.
  • Visão sistêmica e multidisciplinar para integrar aspectos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e engajar diversos perfis profissionais.
  • Orientação a resultados, com foco em qualidade e prazos.



Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Graduado) R$1.500,00

Formato de trabalho : Remoto

Local: São José dos Pinhais – PR

title: Estagiário de Contas a Receber
description:
Atividades:

  • Prestar suporte nas alterações nas descrições das faturas a fim de atender as especificações normativas do cliente;
  • Realizar cancelamento da fatura de pessoa jurídica/física;
  • Apoiar no controle e cadastro das bolsas de descontos no sistema, visando atender os setores requisitantes na divulgação e captação de clientes;
  • Realizar o processo de Cobrança de clientes pessoa Jurídica;
  • Apoiar na análise financeira do aluno que solicitou transferência de turma ou matrícula com dispensa de disciplinas;
  • Gerar boleto para os alunos que contrataram o curso após o faturamento da turma já confirmada;


Requisitos e qualificações:

Escolaridade

  • Ensino Superior em andamento em: Administração, Processo Gerenciais, Gestão Financeira, Ciências Contábeis ou afins

Conhecimentos

  • Conhecimento em processos de faturamento e de cobrança
  • Conhecimento em legislação financeira
  • Excel intermediário


Benefícios:

Bolsa estágio;

Seguro de Vida;

Cartão multibenefícios (Alimentação + Refeição);

Day off de aniversário;

Wellhub by Gympass;

Auxílio home-office.

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

title: High Ticket closer
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Consultor (a) MM - Senior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value

As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.

Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.

Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!




Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Atuação como Consultor (a) MM Funcional nos produtos NTT DATA;


Requisitos:


  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência com SAP MM;
  • Pelo menos 1 projeto completo de implementação ou rollout em SAP S/4HANA;
  • Experiência prática de no mínimo 2 anos com Localização Brasil;
  • Atuação comprovada em projetos com cenários de comércio exterior (exportação/importação);
  • Conhecimento de integração MM com FI, CO, SD e GRC;
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, configuração, testes e suporte pós go-live;
  • Capacidade de redigir especificações funcionais e técnicas claras para ABAP;
  • Capacidade de conduzir workshops e documentar soluções.




Contratação: Regime CLT



Junte-se ao nosso time inspirador, confiável e solidário. Somos apaixonados pelo nosso trabalho, valorizamos a integridade e a responsabilidade pessoal em todos os níveis desde o primeiro dia, tratamos todos com dignidade e respeito, e estendemos nossa responsabilidade à nossa comunidade, à sociedade e ao meio ambiente.



*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Devops Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa DevOps Pleno para se juntar ao nosso time e nos ajudar a construir, escalar e manter ambientes modernos e resilientes na AWS. Se você é apaixonado por automação, infraestrutura como código e cultura DevOps, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no desenho, automação e manutenção de ambientes em AWS;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de CI/CD eficientes e seguras;
  • Trabalhar com clusters Kubernetes (EKS) em produção;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar infraestruturas com Terraform e Helm;
  • Monitorar ambientes e serviços com ferramentas modernas de observabilidade;
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e arquitetura para garantir escalabilidade, performance e segurança;
  • Participar de revisões técnicas, troubleshooting de incidentes e implementação de boas práticas DevOps.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência prática com AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, EKS, etc.);
  • Experiência com Kubernetes (provisionamento, deployment, troubleshooting);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI ou similares);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em redes e arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos;
  • Experiência com Terraform e Helm Charts;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em GCP será um diferencial.

title: Social Media & Content Coordinator
description:
Venha fazer parte do nosso time


Procuramos um(a) profissional que domine as dinâmicas das redes sociais e conteúdo, que tenha visão de futuro sobre o uso da IA na automação, análise e personalização de conteúdo em escala . O coordenador(a) será responsável por liderar a estratégia e operação dos canais sociais, explorando ao máximo as possibilidades da IA para ampliar o alcance, o engajamento e a conversão de usuários no universo das apostas esportivas online.


Responsabilidades

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Title: SAP ABAP Consultant

Location: Remote in Brazil

Type: Contract


Job Description:

• Need an ABAP consultant to do the Brazil tax reform

• Need support for SAP Note implementation

• Support for Prerequisites dependency on SAP notes, work with SAP, should be able to work and analyze current FRICEW objects

• Well, worse with impact analysis

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and enhance ABAP programs to support Brazil's tax reform requirements

• Work closely with functional teams, FI, MM, and SD to implement localization changes

• Modify reports, interfaces, and forms, eg, NFe SPED, as per new tax rules

• Perform unit testing and support integration testing

Requirements

• Strong ABAP development skills, including Reports, BAPIs, BADIs, and Enhancements

• Experience with Brazil localization, not the Fiscal tax procedures, SPED

• Knowledge of S4HANA and tax compliance tools is a plus

• Analyze Brazil's fiscal mandates and SAP ECC capabilities

• Configure SAP ECC to support CBS IBS and Excise Tax

• Implement Nota Fiscal and SPED Fiscal workflows

• Integrate SAP Document and Reporting Compliance tools

• Support for EFD file generation and digital signature

• Update MM and SD pricing rules

• Compatibility with fiscal printers and POS systems if applicable

• Real-time tax calculation and reporting dashboards

• Smart form changes

• Data migration as necessary based on a change in configuration

• Provide testing, training, and go-live support

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Senior Graphic Artist
description:
About Kore

Kore is the trusted infrastructure for the global private capital markets. Through its suite of connected platforms — Kore, KoreTransfer, KoreChain, KoreWire, KoreID, KoreGPT, Kore Issuance, Kore Platform, KoreClearing, and KoreSummit — Kore unites issuers, investors, and regulated intermediaries across a transparent, compliant, and digitally connected ecosystem.


Design and visual communication play a crucial role in how Kore communicates innovation, trust, and leadership in fintech and compliance-driven markets. Every visual asset — from investor materials to digital campaigns — must reflect our precision, sophistication, and purpose.

Role Overview

The Graphic Artist will lead visual design and creative production for the Kore family of companies, managing all brand, marketing, and multimedia assets across digital and print media.


This role combines brand leadership, creative design, and AI-assisted innovation to ensure Kore’s identity remains consistent, compelling, and globally recognized.


Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) and working closely with the VP Technology , Product , and Client Success teams, the Graphic Artist will manage the visual direction for Kore’s platforms and campaigns, ensuring all creative materials align with brand standards and business goals.

The Graphic Artist will also mentor and manage a junior designer , fostering a creative environment that balances speed, quality, and design excellence.

Core Responsibilities 1. Brand & Visual Design Leadership
  • Develop and maintain Kore’s brand identity system , ensuring consistent application across Kore’s subsidiaries and platforms.
  • Produce visual assets for all Kore divisions — Kore, KoreTransfer, KoreChain, KoreWire, KoreID, KoreGPT, Kore Issuance, Kore Platform, KoreClearing, and KoreSummit .
  • Create and maintain brand style guides , color systems, typography standards, and layout frameworks.
  • Partner with the CMO and senior leadership to evolve Kore’s visual storytelling across all touchpoints.
2. Marketing & Corporate Design
  • Design marketing materials including brochures, fact sheets, corporate reports, whitepapers, and investor decks.
  • Create infographics, charts, and diagrams to communicate complex fintech concepts clearly and visually.
  • Develop digital and social media assets for marketing campaigns, press releases, and events.
  • Design presentation templates and visual systems for Kore executives and partner-facing communications.
  • Support KoreSummit with event branding, stage visuals, signage, and multimedia content.
3. Web, Product, and UX Collaboration
  • Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to produce UX/UI assets in Figma and Adobe XD.
  • Translate complex product workflows (KoreChain, KoreClearing, KoreGPT) into visually clear interfaces and infographics .
  • Ensure web design consistency across all Kore websites and partner portals.
  • Support the development of KoreWire and KorePlatform’s front-end experience with responsive visuals and layout guidance.
4. Video & Multimedia
  • Design motion graphics, animated explainers, and promotional videos for social media, investor updates, and product launches.
  • Collaborate with the Marketing and Client Success teams to produce training and onboarding videos for issuers and intermediaries.
  • Maintain video templates, transitions, intros, and lower thirds for Kore’s content channels.
5. AI & Automation Integration
  • Leverage KoreGPT and AI-based design tools (e.g., Adobe Firefly, DALL·E, Runway ML) to accelerate content creation, ideation, and visual enhancement.
  • Automate repetitive creative tasks such as asset resizing, background removal, and layout generation.
  • Experiment with AI-driven visualization tools to generate design concepts aligned with Kore’s brand tone and values.
  • Use KoreGPT to summarize brand guidelines, generate design briefs, and assist in creative ideation sessions.
6. Project & Team Management
  • Manage and mentor a junior designer , assigning projects, reviewing work, and providing constructive feedback.
  • Prioritize and balance multiple design projects under tight deadlines while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Collaborate with the marketing, product, and client success teams to align creative output with campaign goals and client needs.
  • Oversee external vendors or freelancers for specialized design, print, or motion projects when needed.
  • Maintain Kore’s digital asset management system (DAM) to ensure all assets are version-controlled and accessible.
7. Cross-Department Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • CMO – for campaign strategy and brand direction.
  • CRO – for sales presentations and visual sales enablement materials.
  • CBO – for partner program design and visual assets for ecosystem expansion.
  • VP Technology – for UI/UX coordination and product interface visuals.
  • Client Success Team – for training and onboarding materials for issuers and intermediaries.

  • Produce visual assets for all Kore divisions — Kore, KoreTransfer, KoreChain, KoreWire, KoreID, KoreGPT, Kore Issuance, Kore Platform, KoreClearing, and KoreSummit .
  • Create and maintain brand style guides , color systems, typography standards, and layout frameworks.
  • Partner with the CMO and senior leadership to evolve Kore’s visual storytelling across all touchpoints.
2. Marketing & Corporate Design
  • Design marketing materials including brochures, fact sheets, corporate reports, whitepapers, and investor decks.
  • Create infographics, charts, and diagrams to communicate complex fintech concepts clearly and visually.
  • Develop digital and social media assets for marketing campaigns, press releases, and events.
  • Design presentation templates and visual systems for Kore executives and partner-facing communications.
  • Support KoreSummit with event branding, stage visuals, signage, and multimedia content.
3. Web, Product, and UX Collaboration
  • Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to produce UX/UI assets in Figma and Adobe XD.
  • Translate complex product workflows (KoreChain, KoreClearing, KoreGPT) into visually clear interfaces and infographics .
  • Ensure web design consistency across all Kore websites and partner portals.
  • Support the development of KoreWire and KorePlatform’s front-end experience with responsive visuals and layout guidance.
4. Video & Multimedia
  • Design motion graphics, animated explainers, and promotional videos for social media, investor updates, and product launches.
  • Collaborate with the Marketing and Client Success teams to produce training and onboarding videos for issuers and intermediaries.
  • Maintain video templates, transitions, intros, and lower thirds for Kore’s content channels.
5. AI & Automation Integration
  • Leverage KoreGPT and AI-based design tools (e.g., Adobe Firefly, DALL·E, Runway ML) to accelerate content creation, ideation, and visual enhancement.
  • Automate repetitive creative tasks such as asset resizing, background removal, and layout generation.
  • Experiment with AI-driven visualization tools to generate design concepts aligned with Kore’s brand tone and values.
  • Use KoreGPT to summarize brand guidelines, generate design briefs, and assist in creative ideation sessions.
6. Project & Team Management
  • Manage and mentor a junior designer , assigning projects, reviewing work, and providing constructive feedback.
  • Prioritize and balance multiple design projects under tight deadlines while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Collaborate with the marketing, product, and client success teams to align creative output with campaign goals and client needs.
  • Oversee external vendors or freelancers for specialized design, print, or motion projects when needed.
  • Maintain Kore’s digital asset management system (DAM) to ensure all assets are version-controlled and accessible.
7. Cross-Department Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • CMO – for campaign strategy and brand direction.
  • CRO – for sales presentations and visual sales enablement materials.
  • CBO – for partner program design and visual assets for ecosystem expansion.
  • VP Technology – for UI/UX coordination and product interface visuals.
  • Client Success Team – for training and onboarding materials for issuers and intermediaries.

title: Shopify Web Designer
description:
Company Description

Step Labs is a web development and design agency dedicated to partnering with 7-8 figure e-commerce brands to drive revenue growth. We focus on helping ambitious founders scale their businesses efficiently through research-focused split tests. Our custom revenue growth systems guarantee a 30% revenue uplift within 3 months through weekly split-tests. We are passionate about helping our clients achieve measurable success and sustainable growth.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Shopify focussed Web Designer. The Shopify Web Designer will be responsible for designing and implementing high-quality, responsive web designs. Day-to-day tasks include graphic design, front-end development, and creating graphics that enhance the user experience. The web designer will collaborate closely with our team to ensure that all designs align with our clients' brand identity and contribute to their revenue growth.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Web Design and Responsive Web Design
  • Fluency in English - do not apply if you are not fluent in english﻿
  • Strong skills with autolayout in Figma, and with creating high-quality graphics in Adobe CC
  • Experience working with Shopify and an understanding of e-commerce design principles
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote setting
  • Problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing project requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Web Design, Graphic Design, or a related field is preferred
  • Experience in conducting user research and implementing data-driven design changes is a plus

title: Marketing Content Specialist
description:
Marketing Content Specialist


How to Stand Out


When applying, send an email to and please include:

  • In the subject line write the subject line from the top of this job description.
  • Your answer to this question: if you were an animal, what animal would you be and why?
  • Your answer to this question: What does this quote mean to you personally? "The best way to know any future is to cause one"
  • Three content samples (ads, reels, or emails)


Department: Marketing

Type: Full-Time (Remote)

Pay Range: $1,500 – $2,200 USD / month + performance bonus


About the Role


Your mission: capture real customer wins and turn them into daily content across ads, social, and email. This role owns the proof-fed Ad Factory that delivers “more, better, new” creatives every week.

Raw > polished. Volume > perfection. Consistency compounds.


What You'll Do


  • Harvest Proof: collect screenshots, testimonials, videos, reviews, and milestones weekly.
  • Build Ads: use AI tools (ChatGPT, Descript, Claude, OpusClip, Canva AI) to write hooks, edit clips, and assemble 10–50 ad variants/week.
  • Publish Daily: post proof-driven content on FB, IG, YT, TikTok, LinkedIn + send 2 emails/week.
  • Track Performance: monitor creative winners and cost per engaged lead.


Success Metrics


  • 10–50 new ad variants / week
  • Daily organic posts across platforms
  • 2 emails / week built from real proof
  • 70 % + of content sourced from actual customer wins

You Are


  • A fast executor who loves shipping daily
  • Skilled at short-form editing (CapCut / Descript / OpusClip)
  • Comfortable writing short copy (hooks / CTAs / captions)
  • AI-native — you already use ChatGPT or Claude in your workflow
  • Organized, fluent in English, and hungry to learn


Compensation


  • Full-Time $1,500 – $2,200 USD / month
  • $100–$300 bonus for hitting output + ROI goals


Stack


ChatGPT • Claude • Descript • OpusClip • Canva • Lumen5 • CapCut • Publer • HubSpot / HighLevel • Notion • Zapier / Make
